newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index continues ascent.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index continues ascent.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index again moved higher last week with a gain of 59 points or 1.81 percent. The All Ordinaries Index rose 1.06 percent. Changes, in percent:
May 23 May 16 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The index rose gain as interest in junior resource stocks spilled over from the main market despite a quiet gold sector, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
Strong performances included nickel hopefuls Preston Resources, up 31 cents to A$1.60, Capricorn Resources, up five cents to 50 cents, and Defiance Mining, up six cents to 26 cents.
Gawler Craton stocks also showed signs of life. Helix Resources rose 52 cents to A$1.90 and Equinox Resources firmed 12 cents to 58 cents.
Other good price performances included Cutters Ridge, which was three cents at 13 cents. Junior oil and gas explorer Carnarvon Petroleum rose 0.5 to 2.7 cents.

Falls included Precious Metals, down 2.5 cents to 20 cents, Lonestar, down three cents to 26 cents, Denehurst, down three cents to 7.5 cents, and Cambridge Gulf Exploration, down three cents to 17 cents.
